response.courseDescription: 521 Longitudinal Integrated Clerkship I Covers the seven core disciplines in medicine: family medicine, internal medicine, general surgery, pediatrics, psychiatry, obstetrics and gynecology, and neurology; clinical experiences will be interleaved throughout the entire sequence of LIC courses and will focus on working with a small number of preceptors in each discipline for a continuity experience between teacher and learner. INVALID GRADING TYPE.
